WITH account_shares AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS value
    FROM account_shares
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT account_shares.share
    FROM account_shares
    CROSS JOIN average_share
    WHERE account_shares.share > average_share.value
)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(order_count)
        FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id) AS counts
        WHERE order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) > (SELECT value FROM average_share)) AS total_orders,
       AVG(above_average.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(above_average.share - average_share.value) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
CROSS JOIN average_share
